description:
Vital Recorder 1.16.6 is open on the Windows desktop with the file '0002.vital' from the VitalDB open dataset already loaded. The track window shows waveform traces from a noncardiac surgery at Seoul National University Hospital. The toolbar at the top-left shows six icon buttons.

Your task:
1. Export the loaded vital signs data to CSV format. The export function can be accessed by clicking the fifth toolbar icon from the left (it looks like overlapping document/export icons). This opens a standard Windows 'Save As' dialog with 'Comma-Seperated Values (*.csv)' pre-selected as the file type.
2. In the Save As dialog, navigate to the Desktop folder.
3. Change the file name to 'case_0002_export.csv' and click Save.
4. The exported CSV file should be saved at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_0002_export.csv and contain the vital signs data columns from the recording.
